answer: Bonded collateral makes each identity costly to operate: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus evidence, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), not as k independent fines. Detection can impose an exponential multiplier on total swarm capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery of slashed stake. A thread of shared signed votes exposes coordination, sending a ripple through the escrows; jade, one participating identity, cannot escape the collective penalty by splitting its stake.
